critical_code_review_comments: i18n implementation working correctly - t() function properly resolves translations with fallback to French
401 interceptor now dispatches custom event instead of hard reload, preventing full page reloads
Camera IA module has proper AI model failover chain (gemini -> openai)
OnboardingWizard properly checks localStorage for onboarding completion
Subscription gate blocks premium features for expired trial users (working as designed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from iteration 21 verified working: i18n language switching with 20+ languages (FR, EN, ES, DE, AR, ZH, Kiswahili, Hausa, Yoruba, Wolof, etc.), Camera IA page with 5 analysis modes using Gemini AI, Satellite zone capture/analysis, Farmer onboarding wizard, 401 interceptor fix.
